title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisional Measures for Cooperation between Relevant Departments of People's Courts and Supervisory Departments in Verifying Clues of Disciplinary and Legal Violations
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Interim Measures of the Relevant Departments of People's Courts for Cooperating with Supervisory Departments in Verifying Disciplinary and Illegal Clues

Fa Fa [2009] No. 56

To all local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

We hereby issue the Interim Measures of the Relevant Departments of People's Courts for Cooperating with Supervisory Departments in Verifying Disciplinary and Illegal Clues for your diligent implementation. Please report any issues encountered during implementation to this Court.

November 24, 2009

Interim Measures of the Relevant Departments of People's Courts for Cooperating with Supervisory Departments in Verifying Disciplinary and Illegal Clues

Article 1 These Measures are formulated in accordance with the Working Regulations on Supervisory Work of People's Courts to improve the working mechanism for mutual cooperation between the relevant departments of people's courts and supervisory departments, and to promote the organic integration of judicial supervision and disciplinary supervision.

Article 2 Supervisory departments shall exercise unified management over clues of disciplinary and illegal violations. Any clues of disciplinary and illegal violations received by the relevant departments and staff of people's courts shall be handed over to the supervisory department for unified processing.

Where the relevant department discovers clues of disciplinary and illegal violations in the course of case filing, trial, enforcement, retrial, case review, case evaluation, or other work, it shall, after the department head signs the document, issue a letter of transfer for such clues, and transfer the clues together with the relevant materials to the supervisory department for processing.

Article 3 With respect to the clues of disciplinary and illegal violations it receives, the supervisory department may assign personnel from the relevant departments to participate in the supervisory department's own verification, or may assign the matter to the relevant department of the same court for assistance in verification.

Personnel participating in the verification work shall maintain confidentiality, pay attention to methods and approaches, and reduce adverse impacts on trial, enforcement work, and court staff.

Article 4 Where the supervisory department assigns a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation to a relevant department for assistance in verification, it shall obtain the approval of the head of the supervisory department. Where it is necessary to assign personnel from the relevant department to participate in the verification, it shall obtain the approval of the court leadership.

Article 5 After receiving a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation assigned by the supervisory department for assistance in verification, the relevant department shall, in principle, assign the integrity supervisor to take the lead in handling the matter. For a department that has not yet appointed an integrity supervisor, the department head may designate a specific person to take the lead in handling the matter. After receiving a notice from the supervisory department requesting participation in verification, the relevant department shall, as required by the supervisory department, designate the integrity supervisor or other personnel to provide cooperation.

When the relevant department carries out verification work, there shall be no fewer than two verification personnel.

Article 6 Where a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation that the relevant department cooperates in verifying involves a concluded case, the verification personnel may require the case handler of the case in question to provide explanations and clarifications on the relevant issues; they may gather information from the clue reporter, the case parties, or other knowledgeable persons; and they may, after obtaining approval from the head of their own department or the supervisory department, access the case file.

Article 7 Where a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation that the relevant department cooperates in verifying involves a pending case, the verification personnel may require the case handler of the case in question to provide explanations and clarifications on the relevant issues; they may gather information from the clue reporter; and they may, after obtaining approval from the head of their own department or the supervisory department, inspect the case file, or gather information from the case parties or other knowledgeable persons.

Article 8 After the relevant department has verified a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation assigned to it by the supervisory department for verification, it shall prepare a verification report and submit it together with the relevant materials and the opinions of the department head to the supervisory department for review. After review, the supervisory department shall handle the matter as follows:

(1) If the matter is suspected of a disciplinary violation and may result in disciplinary sanctions, it shall decide to initiate an investigation or further verification.

(2) If the disciplinary violation is minor and does not warrant disciplinary sanctions, it may recommend admonishing the person under investigation. If organizational action is required, it may submit written recommendations to the organizational and personnel department with the authority over cadre management.

(3) If the conduct does not constitute a disciplinary violation but involves issues of work attitude or work style, it may recommend a cautionary talk or criticism education for the person under investigation.

(4) If the reported content is unfounded, it shall terminate the verification process and, by appropriate means and within a certain scope, clarify the facts for the person under investigation and eliminate any adverse effects.

Article 9 After the relevant department has verified a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation assigned to it by the supervisory department for verification, if it considers that the case in question requires a retrial or handling under the trial supervision procedure, it shall, with the consent of the supervisory department, transfer the matter to the relevant department for processing according to law.

Article 10 After the relevant department has verified a clue of disciplinary or illegal violation assigned to it by the supervisory department for verification, it shall submit written recommendations to the disciplinary inspection and supervisory department on how to respond to the informant or complainant, and shall jointly carry out the work of responding to the informant or complainant.

Article 11 Where the supervisory department transfers to the relevant department for processing petition materials of the types of retrial applications, appeals, or criticisms and suggestions, the department head shall read and process them, and directly respond to the petitioner with the result. If the supervisory department requires feedback on the result, the relevant department shall provide written feedback to the supervisory department together with the result and the opinions of the department head.

Article 12 Each department shall analyze the petition and report materials reflecting issues within its own department, identify emerging or trending issues, promptly study and propose measures for improvement, and submit a copy of such measures to the supervisory department.

Article 13 Where clues of disciplinary or illegal violations are concealed and not reported, or the content of such clues is leaked in violation of regulations, the disciplinary responsibility of the responsible persons shall be pursued.

Article 14 These Measures shall be interpreted by the Supreme People's Court.

Article 15 These Measures shall take effect as of the date of issuance.
